title.narrative: Strengthening Integrated Resources Management in Coastal Communities in Quezon, Philippines through Participatory Governance

description.narrative: It aims to protect the economic and political rights of municipal fishers by forming Integrated Fisheries and Aquatic Resources Management Councils in Lamon Bay in Quezon Province to enhance their participation in the local governance of their resources. To promote coordination and cooperation among the LGUs, particularly in pooling manpower and financial resources for bay-wide coastal and fisheries resources management in Lamon Bay. And to train local government units and other stakeholders who will potentially be designated as Municipal Fisheries Officers mandated to implement the Fisheries Management Areas (FMAs).
